findings.description: Cost-tier filtering runs before retention (api.py select_model), so when the incumbent's lane was the only subscription-tier option the configured-fallback pool can sit in a metered tier. The plan states this precedence in D4 and the owner accepted the trade-off; the tier is derivable from the persisted selected.assignment.
findings.resolution: Accepted trade-off recorded in design D4 and the Risks section; no new contract field.

findings.description: A permanently excluded incumbent keeps retained:true with selected:null, and the client (agents_config.resolve_archetype_for_phase) then dispatches the static incumbent the policy excluded. This is pre-existing behavior and an explicit non-goal of the change (design Non-goals, D3 rationale).
findings.resolution: Out of scope; a follow-up change could surface the contradiction to the operator instead of dispatching statically.

findings.description: The feature branch (b666e218) is 429 commits behind origin/main. The router files the plan names are unchanged on main; phase_agent.py (+49/-6, environment detection) and agents_config.py (+144, human principals) gained unrelated code. Cited line anchors will shift.
findings.resolution: tasks.md header requires each package to rebase onto main before its first commit and re-anchor cited lines.

findings.description: D2 defaults a provider-less dispatch to claude_code before resolution. For a non-Claude harness that does not set AGENT_TYPE this routes the incumbent to the wrong vendor's catalog. It is the same default build_phase_dispatch_payload already applied after resolution, so no new exposure, but the open question is recorded.
findings.resolution: Recorded as an open question in the session log; non-Claude harnesses set AGENT_TYPE as today.
